patch.description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Change Order Requests (COR).
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: ID of the contract (Prime, Purchase Order, or Work Order Contract) the change order requests belong to.

id.description: ID of an existing change order request to update. Omit to create a new request.

change_order_package_id.description: ID of the change order package (batch) this request belongs to.

description.description: Detailed description of the change order request. May contain HTML.

due_date.description: Date the change order request is due, in ISO 8601 format.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order request was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

number.description: Human-readable number identifying the change order request within its contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form data payload from the external system that created this record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this record in an external or integrated system.

paid_date.description: Date the change order request was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

revision.description: Revision number, incremented each time the change order request is revised.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact to the project schedule, in days.

status.description: Workflow status of the change order request. Defaults to `draft` when omitted on create.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order request.

get.description:
Return a list of all Change Order Requests (COR) to a specific Contract in a Project.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: ID of the contract (Prime, Purchase Order, or Work Order Contract) the change order requests belong to.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Parameter affecting the level of detail returned. The `extended` view includes the total tax amount for each Change Order Request.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

Added support for attaching files to Change Order Requests. You can now provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, `image_ids`, or `document_management_document_revision_ids`.

Added support for linking Change Orders (PCOs) to Change Order Requests:
- `change_order_ids`: Array of PCO IDs to link. Only supported for three-tier projects.

x-changelog.summary: Return 404 for deleted Change Order Requests; add filters[include_deleted] to show
x-changelog.description: GET /change_order_requests/{id} now returns 404 Not Found when the requested Change Order Request has been deleted. To access deleted records, pass filters[include_deleted]=with (includes deleted alongside live records) or filters[include_deleted]=only (deleted records only). Previously, deleted records were returned with a 200 response without any filter.

invoiced_date.description: Date the change order request was invoiced (YYYY-MM-DD).

number.description: Human-readable number identifying the change order request within its contract.

origin_data.description: Free-form data payload from the external system that created this record.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this record in an external or integrated system.

paid_date.description: Date the change order request was paid (YYYY-MM-DD).

position.description: Sort position of the change order request relative to others in its contract.

private.description: If true, visible to admins only; otherwise visible to those with access to the parent contract.

revision.description: Revision number, incremented each time the change order request is revised.

schedule_impact_amount.description: Estimated impact to the project schedule, in days.

signed_change_order_received_date.description: Date the signed change order was received from the vendor (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Workflow status of the change order request.

title.description: Short title summarizing the change order request.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the change order request was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

contract.description: Contract details (present if associated contract exists)

vendor.description: Vendor associated to the contract (if applicable)

batch.description: Change Order Batch this request belongs to (if any)

status.description: Workflow status of the change order batch.

400.description: Can not update Change Order Request due to errors.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

403.description: User does not have right permissions.

x-changelog.description: Adds the "currency_configuration.currency_iso_code" string field
Add "currency_configuration.base_currency_iso_code" string fields

Added support for attaching files to Change Order Requests. You can now provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, `image_ids`, or `document_management_document_revision_ids`. To preserve any pre-existing attachments, you must provide their IDs in the `attachment_ids` array.

Added support for linking Change Orders (PCOs) to Change Order Requests:
- `change_order_ids`: Array of PCO IDs to link. Only supported for three-tier projects.

x-changelog.summary: Permit revision field for create and update
x-changelog.description: The "revision" integer field can now be set when creating or updating a Change Order Request. Only supported for three-tier change order projects.
